verdict.rationale: Obsidian's docs list Version history as a Sync feature that lets you view or restore previous versions of a note, which covers the core of the story. It ships through the separate Obsidian Sync add-on rather than the base app. missing for 10: evidence of recovering deleted notes, in-depth docs on how version history works (retention, UI), independent or hands-on corroboration, availability without the Sync add-on.
